## AI-Assisted Contributions

AI-assisted development is permitted. Contributors remain fully responsible for
all code and other changes they submit, regardless of whether AI tools were
used during development.

AI-tool attribution in commit messages is not used in this project. AI
systems are ephemeral, non-deterministic tools, and commit messages usually
do not record the prompt, model version, or human edits. Such attribution
therefore provides little useful information and can read as promotional.

Please do not add `Co-Authored-By`, `Assisted-by`, `Generated-by`, or
similar trailers referring to AI systems. Attribution in merge-request or
issue comments is fine and encouraged, but not required.

We implore you to reply in your own human words. If you only act as a proxy
between your AI tool of choice and the maintainers, the maintainers can do
the work faster by prompting an AI tool directly.

The merge request creator is responsible for reviewing, understanding, and
taking full responsibility for the submitted changes.
